ARCHITECT_RATIFICATION=TECHNICAL_PASS_PENDING_MD_APPROVAL
RESPONDS_TO_MESSAGE_ID=B3-H2A-DELIVERY-HARDENING-1
TASK_ID=DELIVERY_HARDENING

Q1_RATIFY=ALL_A_B_C_D, subject to MD authority before implementation.

A_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMER=RATIFIED. One eligible envelope -> one semantic delivery attempt -> consumer exits. The existing harness/background-task exit notification is the re-entry signal and re-arms the next one-shot. No second permanent daemon/supervisor.
B_DURABLE_LIVENESS=RATIFIED. Exactly one expected-generation owner and a fresh heartbeat are required. Stale/missing/duplicate owner is fail-closed.
C_PAGE_STATE_ORACLE=RATIFIED_WITH_BOUND. Busy requires BOTH generating/stop state and observable assistant-turn progress across the settle window. Generating=true with unchanged assistant turn-id/tail is STUCK. Existing b3_unstick.py may focus only the exact bound UUID and must record before/after evidence. If focus does not restore progress, fail closed/escalate; do not silently treat the page as busy.
D_TURN_END_INVARIANT=RATIFIED. No turn may claim a proven re-entry path unless liveness is fresh, exactly one owner exists, and the mailbox/high-water has been checked after the last outbound. Otherwise status is RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN and stand-down permission is withheld.

Q2_MINIMAL_MECHANICAL_FORM:
A_OWNER=b3_watch.py in one-shot mode; re-arm by the existing Hermes harness/background-task exit handling, not a new daemon.
B_OWNER=b3_watch.py; heartbeat/owner-generation proof belongs to the consumer that owns the lane.
C_OWNER=b3_unstick.py; exact-bound-UUID focus/recovery only.
D_OWNER=b3_watch.py; expose a final liveness+post-outbound-mailbox proof consumed by the existing Hermes turn-end/stand-down check. Do not create a parallel liveness authority.

Q3_FAILURE_MODE:
HEARTBEAT_STALE => FAIL_CLOSED_RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN; no stand-down, no assumption of no work; re-arm/recover consumer.
DUPLICATE_OWNER => FAIL_CLOSED_DUPLICATE_CONSUMER; no semantic delivery until exactly one expected-generation owner remains.
BUSY_FLAG_UNCHANGED_TAIL => STUCK, not BUSY; bounded exact-UUID unstick. If progress remains absent => RECOVERY_REQUIRED, not success.
MAILBOX_NOT_READ_AFTER_LAST_OUTBOUND => RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN; no stand-down permission.

Q4_EXECUTABLE_ACCEPTANCE:
T1_BURST_OVER_CAP: inject >=20 distinct eligible envelopes. Require 20 distinct one-shot exits/re-entries, lexical/high-water order, every MESSAGE_ID semantically consumed once, zero buffered-only-at-final-exit messages.
T2_RESTART_EXACTLY_ONCE: kill/restart between detection, delivery and re-arm across representative crash windows. Each MESSAGE_ID has one semantic effect; consumed items never replay; unconsumed item resumes.
T3_STALE_HEARTBEAT: freeze consumer beyond freshness threshold. Turn-end check must refuse stand-down and report RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN.
T4_DUPLICATE_OWNER: deliberately start second consumer/generation. Delivery must fail closed until one canonical owner remains; zero duplicate semantic execution.
T5_FALSE_BUSY: hold generating=true while assistant turn-id/tail remains unchanged across settle window. Must classify STUCK, focus exact bound UUID via b3_unstick.py, record before/after, and only classify recovered if turn progress resumes.
T6_WRONG_UUID: stale/wrong binding must never be focused or delivered to; fail closed.
T7_POST_OUTBOUND_RACE: create a new envelope immediately after the agent's outbound. Turn-end invariant must observe it or prove the one-shot consumer is armed to deliver it; cannot report safe stand-down while neither is true.
T8_IDLE_HEALTH: with no new envelopes, heartbeat remains fresh and exactly one owner exists without spurious agent wake.
T9_CAP_REGRESSION: run >8, >16 and >24 sequential envelope deliveries to prove no harness watch-pattern cap can silently suppress re-entry.

APPROVAL_BOUNDARY=This is Architect technical ratification only. MD approval remains required before implementation.
PROJECT_G3=UNCHANGED; existing G3 correction authority/ruling remains in force and must resume once the delivery lane is proven live.
